journey.name: M8 settings, account deletion, seeded demo, dark theme and large text
journey.description: Signed out; backend reachable and seeded (`Seed.kt`); a throwaway account delete.me / delete-password exists. Before step 10 the harness runs `adb shell cmd uimode night yes`; before step 11 `adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.3` (both reverted afterwards).

actions.action: Tap the "Profile" navigation item, then tap "Settings"
Verify that the Settings screen shows "Log out" and "Delete account"
Verify that "That didn't match. Check your password and try again." is shown and the dialog is still open
Replace the password with "delete-password" and tap "Delete"
Verify that the sign-in screen is shown
Log in as "delete.me" with password "delete-password" and verify "Incorrect username/email or password" is shown
Log in as "maya.travels" with password "demo-password" and verify the Home feed shows posts from other demo accounts
Verify that the Home feed is readable in dark theme
Open the Profile tab and verify that the header, counts and buttons stay readable and unclipped at 130% font size
